name: aisdlc-marketplace
description: Stack-agnostic AI-SDLC workflow (goals, clarification, ADRs, governance gates, dependency-ordered implementation) plus pluggable stack plugins, and the goal plugin: a governed workflow that triages each task and runs a complex one a sub-task at a time.

plugins.name: aisdlc
plugins.description: Core AI-SDLC workflow: init, create-goal, challenge, adr, govern, implement.

plugins.name: aisdlc-nodejs
plugins.description: Node.js stack plugin for aisdlc: Node.js 24+, coding standards, lint/coverage gates, SonarQube analysis, dependency vulnerability scans, and Express REST API/auth/JWT practices.

plugins.name: goal
plugins.description: Goal workflow: triage each task as simple or complex, then plan, govern, implement, review and commit a complex task one sub-task at a time, tracked in a ledger.
